comment: Source is not published. FroeZeXWidget::appendContextMenu adds a separator and one MenuEntry carrying a string held on the widget, and no MenuItem at all, so there is nothing on this module's menu to write a line about. Param 0 is the continuous encoder at the centre of the panel; params 1 to 8 are the buttons the panel prints L1 to L4 and R1 to R4, which the manual describes as doing the same thing as the matching boxes on the touchscreen.
